Rashi on Ketubot 27b:10:1.hebrew: השתא נמי - כיון דרחמא לה לגבירתה או דדחלה מינה, אתיא ומשקרא ואמרה טהורה היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:10:1.english: Now too - Since she loves her mistress or fears her, she will come and lie and say, "She is pure."

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:10:2.hebrew: תרתי לא עבדא - חדא למשתק בקלקולה, ועוד דתיתי ותשקר:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:10:2.english: She will not do two [things] - One, to remain silent about her disgrace, and another, that she would come and lie.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:11:1.hebrew: אחא מבי חוזאה - שהלך אביו שם והוליכו עמו וגדלו שם, ומת אביו, וחזר לעירו ותבע חלקו בנכסי אביו:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:11:1.english: A brother from Bei Choza'a - For his father went there, took him with him, and raised him there; and his father died, and he returned to his city and claimed his share in his father's property.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:11:2.hebrew: א"ל - רב חסדא לההוא אחא:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:11:2.english: He said to him - Rav Ḥisda [said] to that brother.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:11:3.english: He is speaking well to you - For he does not recognize you, because you left without the trace of a beard [and came with the trace of a beard].

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:11:4.english: And Joseph recognized his brothers - For when he parted from them, they already had the trace of a beard.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:12:1.hebrew: א"ל - רב חסדא למרי:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:12:1.english: He said to him - Rav Chisda [said] to Mari.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:12:2.english: Go, you bring them - [Bring] those witnesses who know him, and they will testify for you that he is not your father's son.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:12:3.hebrew: השתא נמי - כיון דדחלי מיניה, אתו ומשקרי:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:12:3.english: Now too - Since they are afraid of him, they will come and lie.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:12:4.hebrew: תרתי לא עבדי - חדא דשתקי מלהעיד אמת, וחדא דמסהדי שיקרא:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:12:4.english: Two [things] they do not do - One, that they remain silent from testifying the truth, and one, that they testify falsely.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:13:1.english: Let us say [it is a dispute between] Tannaim - [Regarding] her maidservant, whether she is believed or not.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:13:2.hebrew: זו עדות - עדות זו של שבויה, הכל כשרים בה: איש ואשה, תינוק ותינוקת:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:13:2.english: This testimony - [Regarding] this testimony of a captive woman, all are qualified [to testify] in it: a man and a woman, a male child and a female child.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:14:1.english: [That] of Rav Pappi and Rav Ashi - Who said above [that] her maidservant is believed.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:14:2.hebrew: ודאי תנאי היא - על כרחך יאמרו אנן דאמרי' כי מתניתא בתרייתא, מדקשיא להו קמייתא:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:14:2.english: [It is] certainly [a dispute between] tanna’im - Perforce they will say, "We hold like the latter baraita," since the first [baraita] poses a difficulty for them.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:14:3.english: [The opinion] of Rav Pappa - Who said [that her maidservant] is not believed.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:14:4.hebrew: מי לימא תנאי היא - כלומר, דחוק הוא לומר אנא דאמרי כי מתניתא קמייתא, או יוכל לתרץ מתניתא בתרייתא נמי כוותיה, למימר שפחתה כעצמה דמי והרי היא בכלל "חוץ מהימנה" דקתני בה, או תירוצא אחרינא:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:14:4.english: Do we say it is [a dispute between] tanna'im - That is to say: is he forced to say, "I state [my ruling] in accordance with the first baraita," or can he reconcile the latter baraita according to his [view] as well — to say [that] her maidservant is like herself, and she is [thus] included in "except for her" that is taught in it — or [by] another resolution?

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:15:1.hebrew: אמר לך רב פפא כי תניא ההיא - דקתני הכל נאמנים, ואפילו שפחה דידה, במסיחה לפי תומה:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:15:1.english: Rav Pappa could say to you: When that [baraita] is taught - [That baraita] which teaches "everyone is believed" — and even her maidservant — [refers to] when she speaks casually [without intent to testify].

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:16:1.english: Rav Ḥana of Carthage relates - Rav Ḥanan from Carthage was recounting this incident.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:17:1.english: This abode - It is an oath.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:18:1.hebrew: ואעפ"כ - שאסרו עליו לפי שכהן היה:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:18:1.english: And even so - [Even though] they forbade [her] to him because he was a priest.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:18:2.english: When she goes out - [While] he is in the courtyard.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:18:3.english: She goes out at the head of her sons - So that the sons will be with them, so that they will not be secluded [together].

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:18:4.english: And when she enters, she enters after her sons - So that he and she will not be in the courtyard while the sons [are] outside.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:19:1.hebrew: בגרושה - כהן שגירש את אשתו, מהו לדור עמו בחצר:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:19:1.english: With a divorcée - A priest who divorced his wife — what is [the law] regarding [her] dwelling with him in [the same] courtyard?

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:1:1.english: Why would I lie - If she wanted [to lie], she could have said, "I hid."

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:20:1.hebrew: לא תנשא בשכונתו - לפי שמכירה ברמיזותיו וקריצותיו, שמא יבואו לידי עבירה:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:20:1.english: She may not marry in his vicinity - Because she is familiar with his hints and winks, [there is a concern] lest they come to transgression.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:3:1.english: In a place of witnesses - For we are witnesses [i.e., it is common knowledge] that at all times there is water [there].

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:4:1.english: Definitely defiled - [This is said] as a rhetorical question.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:5:1.hebrew: לא תתייחד עמו - במסכת גיטין היא: שכיב מרע שכתב ומסר גט לאשתו על מנת שאם מת יהא גט למפרע ולא תיזקק לחליצה, לא תתייחד עמו שמא יבא עליה והוה ליה גט ישן. ותנן: בית הלל אוסרין לפטור בגט ישן, ואיזהו גט ישן? כל שנתייחד עמה מאחר שכתבו לה. וטעמא — גזירה שמא יאמרו גיטה קודם לבנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:5:1.english: She may not enter into seclusion with him - It is [a Mishnah] in Tractate Gittin: [Regarding] a critically ill man who wrote and delivered a bill of divorce to his wife on condition that if he dies it shall be a bill of divorce retroactively, so that she will not require chalitzah — she may not enter into seclusion with him, lest he have intercourse with her and it becomes an outdated bill of divorce. And we learned in a Mishnah: Beit Hillel forbid releasing [a wife] with an outdated bill of divorce; and what is an outdated bill of divorce? Any [case] where he entered into seclusion with her after he wrote it for her. And the reason [is] a decree lest people say her bill of divorce preceded her son.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:6:1.english: And even on the basis of a slave - It is sufficient for her [to have] a slave who was with her.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:6:2.english: That she is familiar with her maidservant - And she will engage in intercourse in her presence.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:1.hebrew: רב אשי אמר הא והא בשפחה דידה - והיינו טעמא דבמתני' מהימנא, והתם לא מהימנא, דשפחה דידה מיחזא חזיא בקילקול גבירתה ושתקה:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:1.english: Rav Ashi said: Both [this and that] are [stated] with regard to her maidservant - And this is the reason that in our Mishnah she is deemed credible, whereas there she is not deemed credible: because her maidservant sees her mistress's misconduct and remains silent.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:2.english: There - Regarding a bill of divorce.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:3.hebrew: דשתיקותה מתירתה - שאינה צריכה שתעיד לומר לא שמשה, אלא שתאמר אני הייתי עמה:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:3.english: Where her silence renders her permitted - For she does not need to testify, saying, "She did not engage in intercourse," rather [it suffices] that she say, "I was with her."

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:4.hebrew: לא מהימנא - להיות זו מותרת על ידה, דאי נמי חזיא לא מסהדא:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:4.english: She is not deemed credible - For this [woman] to be permitted through her, for even if she sees [it], she does not testify.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:6.english: Where her silence - [The silence] of the maidservant.

Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:7.hebrew: אוסרתה - לגבירתה, דכל כמה שאינה מעידה לומר טהורה היא, מחזקינן לה בטמאה. כי מסהדא ואמרה טהורה היא, מהימנא, דלשקורי לאו אורחא, אלא למשתק:
Rashi on Ketubot 27b:9:7.english: Renders her forbidden - [That is,] her mistress, for as long as she does not testify saying she is pure, we presume her to be defiled. When she testifies and says she is pure, she is deemed credible, for it is not her way to lie, only to remain silent.

Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:11:1.hebrew: שפיר קאמר לך, דכתיב "ויכר יוסף" - זה שבא נולד כאן והלך עם אביו למדינת הים, ועתה כשחזר ואמר מרי "לא ידענא לך", מיחזי כשיקרא — כי היה לו לידע אם הוא אחיו אם לאו, כיון שמכירו קודם; להכי קאמר רב חסדא דשפיר קאמר ליה שאינו מכירו, כדאשכחן ביוסף:
Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:11:1.english: "He is speaking well to you, as it is written: 'And Joseph recognized'" - This [man] who came was born here and went with his father overseas, and now when he returned and [Mari] said, "I do not know you," it appears like a lie — for he should have known whether he is his brother or not, since he knew him previously; therefore Rav Ḥisda said that he is speaking well to him [in saying] that he does not recognize him, as we find with Joseph.

Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:12:1.hebrew: אמר ליה אית לי סהדי ומסתפינו מיניה דאיניש אלמא הוא - נראה לר"י, דמיירי שהביא עדים ואומרים: "אותו עדות שאתה שואל, לא נאמר לך כלום עליו", דרגלים לדבר שהוא אלם. "אמר ליה זיל כו'" — פי': לך הבא אותם עדים עצמם שיראים להעיד עליך, שיעידו שאינו אחיך, או שיאמרו שאינם יודעים אם הוא אחיך אם לאו. וקאמר: "השתא נמי" — כיון שיראים ממנו, ישקרו לומר אינו אחיו, או שאינן יודעין אם הוא אחיו. אבל אם אין רגלים לדבר, אין נראה כלל שיהא נאמן לומר דגברא אלמא הוא; דאם לא כן, כל אדם יאמר על חבירו שהוא גברא אלמא, ויביא הוא עדים, ואם לא יביא — יפסיד. ועוד, דקאמר "השתא נמי אתו ומסהדי" — אטו משום דמסתפו מיניה הני סהדי, מסתפו מיניה כולי עלמא?:
Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:12:1.english: He said to him: I have witnesses, but they are afraid of him, for he is a violent man - It appears to the Ri [Rabbi Yitzchak] that [the Gemara] is referring to a case where he brought witnesses, and they say: "Regarding that testimony that you are asking [about], we will not tell you anything about it," for [then] there is a basis to the matter that he is violent. "He said to him: Go, etc." — the explanation is: Go bring those very same witnesses who are afraid to testify against you, so that they may testify that he is not your brother, or that they say they do not know whether he is your brother or not. And [the Gemara] says: "Now too" — since they are afraid of him, they will lie and say he is not his brother, or that they do not know if he is his brother. However, if there is no basis to the matter, it does not appear at all that he should be believed to say that he is a violent man; for if not so, anyone could say about his fellow that he is a violent man, and [then the other] would have to bring witnesses, and if he does not bring [them], he would lose. And furthermore, when [the Gemara] says, "Now too they will come and testify [falsely]" — just because these witnesses are afraid of him, is the whole world afraid of him?

Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:12:2.hebrew: תרתי לא עבדי - שישתקו ולא יעידו האמת, ועוד שיאמרו שקר; וכן גבי שפחה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:12:2.english: They do not do two [things] - [That is,] that they should remain silent and not testify to the truth, and furthermore that they should speak falsehood; and similarly regarding the maidservant.

Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:15:1.hebrew: במסיחה לפי תומה - ואפילו הכי היא ובעלה אינן נאמנין, אע"ג דיוחנן אוכל חלות (לעיל כתובות דף כו.) היה נאמן על עצמו במסיח לפי תומו — הני מילי לתרומה, אבל הכא מעלה עשו ביוחסין. [ואומר ר"י דמסיח לפי תומו אינו כשר דמסיח לפי תומו אינו כשר אלא לעדות אשה דרבנן, כדאמר ביבמות, והכא בשבויה הקילו]:
Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:15:1.english: When she is making an incidental remark - And even so, she and her husband are not believed, even though Yochanan Okhel Challot (above, Ketubot 26a) was believed regarding himself when speaking incidentally — that applies only to terumah, but here they imposed a higher standard regarding lineage. [And Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that one speaking incidentally is valid only for testimony regarding a woman, [which is] rabbinic, as [the Gemara] states in Yevamot, and here regarding a captive woman they were lenient.]

Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:5:1.hebrew: לא תתיחד עמו אלא בעדים - פירוש בקונטרס: משום גט ישן. ולא פירש לטעמיה, דפירש בגיטין (דף עג.) דבמהיום אם מתי מגורשת למפרע משעת נתינה, ולא תתיחד עמו משום חשש קידושין — כמו המגרש אשתו ולנה עמו בפונדקי, בית הלל אומרים צריכה הימנו גט שני (שם דף פא.) [ולא שייך גט ישן כלל לפירוש דהתם], וכן משמע התם בגמרא. אבל לרבינו תם, דמפרש "מה היא באותן הימים" קאי אמהיום אם מתי, ונעשה כאומר "מעת שאני בעולם" — שאין דעתו לגרשה אע"פ שאומר מהיום אלא שעה אחת לפני מיתתו — הוי טעמא משום גט ישן; ובתוספתא משמע כפי' רבינו תם:
Tosafot on Ketubot 27b:5:1.english: "She may not enter into seclusion with him except with witnesses" - Rashi explained: [this is] because of an outdated get. And he did not explain [it] according to his own reasoning, for he explained in Gittin (73a) that in [the case of] "From today if I die," she is divorced retroactively from the time of giving [the get], and she may not enter into seclusion with him because of the concern of [a new] betrothal — like [the case of] "one who divorces his wife and she lodges with him in an inn, Beit Hillel say she requires a second get from him" (there, 81a) [and an outdated get does not apply at all according to the explanation there], and so it is implied there in the Gemara. However, according to Rabbeinu Tam, who explains [that] "What is her [status] during those days?" refers to "From today if I die," and it is treated as if he said "From the time I am [still] in the world" — for he does not intend to divorce her, even though he says "from today," until one hour before his death — the reason is because of an outdated get; and in the Tosefta it is implied like the explanation of Rabbeinu Tam.
